title: [V4][BUSINESS-OS][ENTITLEMENT] Client-owned AI provider connections for the $300/year plan

acceptance_criteria_verified.criterion: Business OS owns commercial subscription entitlement ($300/year plan) separate from provider quota ownership
acceptance_criteria_verified.proof: EntitlementManager blocks provider connections on PLAN_FREE and grants access on BUSINESS_300_ANNUAL.

acceptance_criteria_verified.criterion: Client explicitly authorizes provider connections; shared broker handles authorization and routing without duplicating provider secrets
acceptance_criteria_verified.proof: CognitiveTreasuryBroker stores secret_handle and redacted_fingerprint only; raw secrets are never persisted or exposed.

acceptance_criteria_verified.criterion: Business OS shows connection health, consent/scopes, usage receipts and revoke/disconnect state
acceptance_criteria_verified.proof: get_connection_status returns structured view model and get_receipts exposes EffectReceipt audit history.

acceptance_criteria_verified.criterion: Canary: one tenant connects multiple providers, runs one shared capability, receives a usage/evidence receipt, then revokes one provider without changing tenant identity or breaking others
Variable provider quotas are measured rather than promised as fixed capacity
acceptance_criteria_verified.proof: ProviderConnection tracks VARIABLE_MEASURED tokens_consumed and tokens_remaining_estimate upon execution.
